title: Vrikshasana Ka Balance!
style: 3D animated movie still in the style of a Pixar film, a glossy cute character with big expressive eyes and a small headband, hyper-detailed macro close-up, cinematic soft lighting, rich colours, vertical 9:16

VRIKSHASANA.look: A lean, green tree-like figure with a calm face, standing gracefully on one leg, arms in namaste. Roots are visible at the bottom, suggesting stability.

DIMAAG.look: A shiny, grey, wrinkled brain with big, curious eyes and tiny spectacles, looking smart and thoughtful. It has a small red bindi.

DEEWAR.look: A sturdy, brown brick wall, a bit weathered, with a friendly, patient smile. A small moss patch grows on one side, adding to its character.

scenes.image: [[VRIKSHASANA]] a lean, green tree-like figure standing calmly on one leg, arms in namaste. Roots visible.
scenes.speaker: VRIKSHASANA
scenes.line: Arre main Vrikshasana hoon! Balance sikhata hoon, seedha khada karoon!
scenes.say: अरे मैं वृक्षासन हूँ! बैलेंस सिखाता हूँ, सीधा खड़ा करूँ!

scenes.image: [[VRIKSHASANA]] a lean, green tree-like figure standing calmly on one leg, arms in namaste. Roots visible.
scenes.speaker: VRIKSHASANA
scenes.line: Bole toh ekdum style mein ek taang pe khada hone ka.
scenes.say: बोले तो एकदम स्टाइल में एक टांग पे खड़ा होने का.

scenes.image: [[VRIKSHASANA]] a lean, green tree-like figure standing calmly on one leg, arms in namaste. Roots visible.
scenes.speaker: VRIKSHASANA
scenes.line: Sahi pakde hain! Teri body ko ekdum jhakaas balance dega yeh.
scenes.say: सही पकड़े हैं! तेरी बॉडी को एकदम झकास बैलेंस देगा ये.

scenes.image: [[DIMAAG]] a shiny, grey, wrinkled brain with big, curious eyes and tiny spectacles, looking smart.
scenes.speaker: DIMAAG
scenes.line: Main tera Dimaag hoon, bhidu! Main bhi bolta hoon sun zara.
scenes.say: मैं तेरा दिमाग हूँ, भिडू! मैं भी बोलता हूँ सुन ज़रा.

scenes.image: [[DIMAAG]] a shiny, grey, wrinkled brain with big, curious eyes and tiny spectacles, looking smart.
scenes.speaker: DIMAAG
scenes.line: Jab tu Vrikshasana karega, main ekdum focus ho jata hoon.
scenes.say: जब तू वृक्षासन करेगा, मैं एकदम फोकस हो जाता हूँ.

scenes.image: [[DIMAAG]] a shiny, grey, wrinkled brain with big, curious eyes and tiny spectacles, looking smart.
scenes.speaker: DIMAAG
scenes.line: Dhyaan lagaayega, toh sab kuch achhe se kar paayega, samjha kya?
scenes.say: ध्यान लगाएगा, तो सब कुछ अच्छे से कर पाएगा, समझा क्या?

scenes.image: [[VRIKSHASANA]] a lean, green tree-like figure standing calmly on one leg, arms in namaste. Roots visible.
scenes.speaker: VRIKSHASANA
scenes.line: Balance ka lafda life mein nahi hone dega kabhi.
scenes.say: बैलेंस का लाफड़ा लाइफ में नहीं होने देगा कभी.

scenes.image: [[VRIKSHASANA]] a lean, green tree-like figure standing calmly on one leg, arms in namaste. Roots visible.
scenes.speaker: VRIKSHASANA
scenes.line: Bas ek taang pe khada ho, doosra pair jaangh pe rakh, haath jod le.
scenes.say: बस एक टांग पे खड़ा हो, दूसरा पैर जांघ पे रख, हाथ जोड़ ले.

scenes.image: [[VRIKSHASANA]] a lean, green tree-like figure standing calmly on one leg, arms in namaste. Roots visible.
scenes.speaker: VRIKSHASANA
scenes.line: Yeh yog tera tan aur man dono ko ekdum fit rakh sakta hai.
scenes.say: ये योग तेरा तन और मन दोनों को एकदम फिट रख सकता है.

scenes.image: [[DEEWAR]] a sturdy, brown brick wall, a bit weathered, with a friendly, patient smile. A small moss patch on it.
scenes.speaker: DEEWAR
scenes.line: Arre main Deewar hoon, bhai! Tension nahi lene ka, mujhe pakad le.
scenes.say: अरे मैं दीवार हूँ, भाई! टेंशन नहीं लेने का, मुझे पकड़ ले.

scenes.image: [[DEEWAR]] a sturdy, brown brick wall, a bit weathered, with a friendly, patient smile. A small moss patch on it.
scenes.speaker: DEEWAR
scenes.line: Shuruaat mein thoda mushkil lagega, mera sahara le sakta hai.
scenes.say: शुरुआत में थोड़ा मुश्किल लगेगा, मेरा सहारा ले सकता है.

scenes.image: [[DEEWAR]] a sturdy, brown brick wall, a bit weathered, with a friendly, patient smile. A small moss patch on it.
scenes.speaker: DEEWAR
scenes.line: Dheere-dheere khud hi balance banega, phir main chhutti le loonga.
scenes.say: धीरे-धीरे खुद ही बैलेंस बनेगा, फिर मैं छुट्टी ले लूँगा.

scenes.image: [[VRIKSHASANA]] a lean, green tree-like figure standing calmly on one leg, arms in namaste. Roots visible.
scenes.speaker: VRIKSHASANA
scenes.line: Agar chakkar aate hon ya dard ho, toh zabardasti nahi karne ka.
scenes.say: अगर चक्कर आते हों या दर्द हो, तो ज़बरदस्ती नहीं करने का.

scenes.image: [[VRIKSHASANA]] a lean, green tree-like figure standing calmly on one leg, arms in namaste. Roots visible.
scenes.speaker: VRIKSHASANA
scenes.line: Koi bhi health problem ho, toh Doctor se salah zaroor le lena.
scenes.say: कोई भी हेल्थ प्रॉब्लम हो, तो डॉक्टर से सलाह ज़रूर ले लेना.

scenes.image: [[VRIKSHASANA]] a lean, green tree-like figure standing calmly on one leg, arms in namaste. Roots visible.
scenes.speaker: VRIKSHASANA
scenes.line: Roz thoda-thoda kar, par ek saath zyada karne ka lafda nahi.
scenes.say: रोज़ थोड़ा-थोड़ा कर, पर एक साथ ज़्यादा करने का लाफड़ा नहीं.

scenes.image: [[VRIKSHASANA]] a lean, green tree-like figure standing calmly on one leg, arms in namaste. Roots visible.
scenes.speaker: VRIKSHASANA
scenes.line: Yeh yog tere din ko ekdum fresh bana sakta hai, bhidu.
scenes.say: ये योग तेरे दिन को एकदम फ्रेश बना सकता है, भिडू.

scenes.image: [[VRIKSHASANA]] a lean, green tree-like figure standing calmly on one leg, arms in namaste. Roots visible.
scenes.speaker: VRIKSHASANA
scenes.line: Roz thodi practice se tu ekdum master ban jaayega.
scenes.say: रोज़ थोड़ी प्रैक्टिस से तू एकदम मास्टर बन जाएगा.

scenes.image: [[VRIKSHASANA]] a lean, green tree-like figure standing calmly on one leg, arms in namaste. Roots visible.
scenes.speaker: VRIKSHASANA
scenes.line: Tu din mein kitni baar khud ko balance check karta hai?
scenes.say: तू दिन में कितनी बार खुद को बैलेंस चेक करता है?
